question: If consciousness is fundamental, what is the brain doing? Is it a filter, interface, generative model, or extrinsic appearance of mind?
best_answer: Four models compete: filter (restricts larger awareness), interface (constructs adaptive representation), generative model (predictive processing), and extrinsic appearance (what local mind looks like from outside). The third is closest to active inference; the fourth to analytic idealism. Brain damage cases remain the strongest challenge to any consciousness-first view.
